info.title: Spell Check API
info.description: Fast English spell checker (US and UK): flags misspellings with ranked suggestions, offsets and an auto-corrected text. Drop-in replacement for the retired Bing Spell Check API (format=bing).

parameters.name: text
parameters.example: I recieve alot of emails abuot the the project.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: en-US (default), en-GB or en (any English). Also accepts mkt=en-US like Bing

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: proof (default: spelling + repeated words) or spell (spelling only)

parameters.name: words
parameters.description: Comma-separated custom words to accept (brand names, jargon)

parameters.name: ignore_uppercase
parameters.description: Skip ALL-CAPS words like acronyms (true/false, default true)

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Leave empty for the full response, or bing for the Bing Spell Check v7 response shape

200.description: Errors with suggestions and corrected text
